configure_mot_challenge_dataset: configure MOTChallengeDataset for pedestrian tracking on MOT17 dataset with COCO format annotations
setup_train_pipeline: set up training data pipeline with UniformRefFrameSample, RandomResize, RandomCrop, and RandomFlip transforms
setup_test_pipeline: set up test data pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, and LoadTrackAnnotations transforms
configure_dataloader: configure train and validation dataloaders with TrackImgSampler for image-based sampling
setup_evaluator: set up MOTChallengeMetric evaluator with HOTA, CLEAR, and Identity metrics
